issues.legal_issue: Devolution of property to heirs by succession is not a transfer from an evacuee for the statutory definition of evacuee property.
material_facts: After the property owner died, his heirs claimed the property by succession under Mohammedan law, rather than by a transfer from him.
The heirs acquired their interests by operation of law.
issues.conclusion: The statutory provision covering property obtained from an evacuee by a mode of transfer did not apply to property inherited by the heirs.
issues.legal_principle: Section 2(f)(1) of the Administration of Evacuee Property Act, 1950, concerns property obtained from an evacuee by a mode of transfer, which contemplates a transfer inter vivos and does not include succession by operation of law. Section 40 restricts transfers inter vivos and does not affect devolution on death. No earlier case was relied on for this conclusion.

predicates.evacuee_property_status_proceeding: An administrative proceeding was brought to determine whether property should be treated as evacuee property.
predicates.property_claimed_by_inheritance: Heirs claimed the property because the former owner had died.
predicates.inheritance_occurs_by_operation_of_law: The heirs acquired their interests through succession by operation of law rather than through a transfer made by the former owner.

issues.definition: When an evacuee-property status proceeding concerns property claimed by heirs through succession by operation of law, the property is not treated as obtained from the evacuee by transfer.

issues.legal_issue: Proceedings to declare a person an evacuee and that person's property evacuee property lapse if the person dies before the declaration, and cannot be continued against the heirs to make that declaration.
material_facts: Proceedings had begun to determine whether a person and his property should be declared evacuee and evacuee property.
The person died while an appeal concerning that determination was pending and before a declaration that he was an evacuee had been made.
His property devolved on his heirs under Mohammedan law upon his death.
The authority later continued the proceedings and declared the deceased to be an evacuee and his property to be evacuee property.
The Act provided no procedure for substituting the heirs and continuing the proceedings against them after the person's death.
issues.conclusion: The proceedings lapsed on the person's death; the authority lacked jurisdiction to declare him an evacuee after his death or to declare the property that had devolved on his heirs evacuee property, and its order was set aside.
issues.legal_principle: Sections 2(d) and 2(f) define an evacuee and evacuee property by reference to a person's status and rights or interests in property. Under section 7, notice and inquiry precede a declaration, and section 8 provides for vesting following that declaration; the statutory doctrine of relation-back cannot displace devolution to heirs where the person dies before declaration. Section 43 addresses death after vesting and supports the conclusion that vesting must occur during the alleged evacuee's lifetime. The Code of Civil Procedure's substitution procedure did not apply because the Custodian was not a court; section 45 applied the Code only to specified matters, and the Act contained no provision for continuing the proceedings against heirs. The court distinguished insolvency provisions, including section 93 of the Presidency Towns Insolvency Act and section 17 of the Provincial Insolvency Act, which expressly provide for continuation after death. No earlier case was relied on for the substantive conclusion.

rule.if: evacuee_status_and_property_declaration_proceeding and person_died_before_declaration and property_devolved_to_heirs_by_succession and no_statutory_continuation_mechanism

predicates.evacuee_status_and_property_declaration_: An administrative proceeding was pending to determine whether a person was an evacuee and whether the person's property was evacuee property.
predicates.person_died_before_declaration: The person whose status was being determined died before the authority made the declaration.
predicates.property_devolved_to_heirs_by_succession: The person's property passed to heirs by succession upon the person's death.
predicates.no_statutory_continuation_mechanism: The governing legal scheme provided no procedure for continuing the proceeding against heirs after the person's death.

issues.definition: If an evacuee-status and property-declaration proceeding is pending when the person dies before declaration, the property passes to heirs by succession, and there is no statutory mechanism to continue against them, the proceeding lapses and the authority cannot make the declaration.
